unsealed_extra_policy: Keep evidence/groupA/completion.json solely in the original external B3 archive, preserve exact hash/bytes in new receipt; never add to the original 123-file seal.
portability_rules: Original B4 report, manifest, handoff, formal rows and B3 evidence/QC bytes are immutable. Preserve local paths in originals; supply additive mapping instead of rewriting evidence notes or action hashes.

Selection is a portable subset, not a full copy of the 60-file B4 or 123-file B3 sealed archives. The original checksum manifests document excluded files; copied-file inventory must authenticate exactly the new archive subset.

Excluded source PDFs are not claimed to exist in the repository. Each remains traceable by official URL/version/hash and by included extraction/capture receipts, text/page content and reviewed renderings.

P231/R231 previous U017 identity-only receipt resolves to existing repository data/raw/corpus_quality_batch_c_wave2_2026_10_06/evidence_manifest.json at the pinned baseline; no duplicate file required.
Archived P231 semantics references to code/tests/policy resolve to baseline Git blobs, not current exported state. New current-source tests remain separate from historical snapshot receipts.
Do not import operational scripts, full prepared CSVs, full source worktree inventories, caches, downloaded PDF originals or the unsealed B3 extra into the repository.
